svg.title: Record on the road. Analyse when you return.
svg.desc: Rendered board and cutaway vehicle illustrate three phases: configure and verify on the bench, record bus frames locally during vehicle operation, and host-based retrieval, verification, archiving, decoding and publication. Arrows and connectivity timeline are schematic; no measured vehicle data is shown.

g.text: Record on the road. Analyse when you return.
The device records locally. The host retrieves sealed files when connectivity is available.
Vehicle operation, with or without WiFi
Original files are retained in the host archive; decoded signals are derived from them.
